BoardView.description: The static board view embedded in every observation.

border_x.description: First column belonging to Blue's half (matches the engine's `border_x`).

walls.description: Blocked tiles, static for the match, as `[x, y]` pairs.

EnemyAgentView.description:
One of the opposing colony's agents. The same fields minus `can_move_this_tick`
(a controller does not drive enemies, so their cadence is not exposed).

JellyView.description: A royal-jelly node in the observation.

active.description:
Always `true` in the list (consumed nodes are dropped from it), but kept
explicit to match architecture.md's shape and leave room for a future
recharge variant.

LargeSeedView.description:
A large seed in the observation: where it is, where it came from, what it is
worth, and how long until it takes its next step toward the border.

Every large seed also appears in [`World::seeds`], so a controller that ignores
this list still picks one up by walking onto it. This list is what lets a
controller treat it as an *objective* — contest it, time a jelly to break a
defender parked on it, recall its own before the enemy reaches it, or weigh the
carry penalty of hauling one home.

half.description:
Whose larder it belongs to: the colony that may recall it, and whose opponent
may eat it.

home_x.description: The spawn tile it drifted from, and where its own colony recalls it to.

ticks_to_drift.description:
Ticks until it walks one more tile toward the border. It drifts whether or not
anyone stands on it, so this is a clock, not a suggestion.

value.description: What it banks — and what it weighs while carried. The same number.

OwnAgentView.description:
One of the controller's *own* agents, with the carry-weight cadence
pre-computed so the controller never re-derives it.

can_move_this_tick.description:
Whether this agent may move this tick under carry-weight (see
[`crate::state::Agent::can_move_this_tick`]). A move submitted for an
agent reading `false` is a no-op.

Role.description: The role an agent currently has, derived from the half it stands on.

oneOf.description: On its own half: a defender that can tag enemy raiders.
On the enemy half: a forager that eats caches and carries the load home.

ScoreView.description: Banked score, as the observation spells it (`{ "red": .., "blue": .. }`).

SeedsRemaining.description: Remaining (un-banked-away) seed totals per half, the sweep-progress signal.

blue_half.description: Seeds still to be banked away from Blue's half (what Red must sweep).

red_half.description: Seeds still to be banked away from Red's half (what Blue must sweep).

Team.description:
Which colony a tile or agent belongs to. Red holds the west half, Blue the
east; an agent's *role* (soldier vs. raider) is derived from the half it
stands on, not from the colony it belongs to — see [`crate::state`].

description:
The per-tick observation handed to one team's controller. Fully observable in
v1 (no fog) — a deliberate first-case simplification.

jelly.description:
Active royal-jelly nodes. A node that has been eaten drops out of this list
and reappears in it when it regrows, at the same tile.

large_seeds.description:
The large seeds currently on the board, with their value, home, and drift
clock. Each also appears in `seeds`.

seeds.description:
Every takeable seed tile on the board — uneaten ordinary caches (including
dropped, recoverable ones) **and** large seeds. Walking onto any of these
picks it up; the list does not say which is which, so see `large_seeds`.
